# Parker & Parker Co. LLP

> > A leading intellectual property law firm in India providing comprehensive patent, trademark, and copyright registration and litigation services across multiple jurisdictions.

Parker & Parker Co. LLP is an India-based IP law firm with offices in Ahmedabad and Delhi, specializing in patent prosecution, trademark registration, and copyright protection. The firm serves clients across India, Asia, USA, and Europe with expertise in international IP protection including PCT and Madrid Protocol filings.

## Key Topics

- Intellectual Property (IP)
- Patent Registration & Prosecution
- Trademark Registration & Search
- Copyright Protection
- Brand Protection
- India IP Law
- International IP Protection
- Patent Filing
- Trademark Classification
- Corporate Law
- PCT (Patent Cooperation Treaty)
- Madrid Protocol
- IP Litigation
- Appellate Board
- Nice Classification

## Trademark Services

- [Trademark Registration Services](https://www.parkerip.com/practice-areas/trademark): Trademark registration services with Madrid Protocol and IPO expertise
- [Online Trademark Filing](https://www.parkerip.com/practice-areas/trademark/online-trademark-filing): Streamlined online trademark filing with International Classification guidance
- [Trademark Search](https://www.parkerip.com/practice-areas/trademark/trademark-search): Online trademark search services for brand registration and infringement prevention
- [Trademark Requirements in India](https://www.parkerip.com/practice-areas/trademark/trademark-requirements): Trademark requirements in India including applicant details and specifications
- [How to Choose a Trademark](https://www.parkerip.com/practice-areas/trademark/how-to-choose-trademark): Guide to selecting and naming trademarks for brand protection
- [Service Mark Registration](https://www.parkerip.com/practice-areas/trademark/service-mark): Service mark registration under Indian Trade Marks Act 1999
- [International Trademark Classification](https://www.parkerip.com/practice-areas/trademark/international-trademark-classification): Reference guide to Nice Classification for international trademark registration
- [Trademark FAQs](https://www.parkerip.com/practice-areas/trademark/trademark-faqs): Trademark FAQs covering types, registration, and international protection
